supersession: Additive owner-acceptance status only. The sealed preparation content and its then-pending adoption status remain unchanged.

A.policy: Two primary engagement outcomes: q6_13 reported remittance disposition (five categories plus accepted binary), and q6_14 reported domestic digital participation in 60 days. Retain household eligibility, personal-wording limitation, full supporting quantitative scope and noncausal nonrepresentative interpretation.

B.policy: Focus and conditional blueprint both approved. Main models nominate IAT three-component, IADT two-item and IAFF two-condition candidates, age, education and version-aware geography. Extensions add occupation and first-arrival calendar history after provenance/coverage checks. No automatic scoring, substitutions, collapses, exclusions, imputation, IVS/constituent coentry or extra sensitivity fits.

C.policy: Conditional binary logit; adjusted probabilities, percentage-point differences and average marginal associations over the relevant model sample, not an ideal/at-means woman. References are support-conditional. Covariance/dependence, exact within-support contrasts and defensible numerical uncertainty remain unresolved.

D.policy: One six-test primary family: three overall focal-block associations in each of two main outcomes; conditional Holm step-down at 0.05. Extensions are stability checks; supporting inference is exploratory unless a finite family is declared before analysis. Report all authorized results, failures and deviations; no silent shrinking or post-result shopping. Retrospective specification, not original preregistration.

E.policy: LCA is conditional and complementary. No family, class count or budget is adopted. Assess measurement, optimization, identification, enumeration, sparse/boundary patterns, local dependence and classification uncertainty. No automatic historical composite substitution, four-class mandate, minimum entropy rule or class-defining-content external validation; qualitative component remains protected.

F.policy: Design only: first no-fit verification wave P1 carrier/membership/order/internal-key and screen-support; P2 version-aware coverage and response states; P3 preserved clocks/first-arrival history/geography; P4 applicability and fixed-candidate complete coverage. No new score, fit, prediction, classes or row-level outputs. Source/access/output/retention/ownership and runtime bounds remain to be bound.
